Hannah Li: welcome omar!! i'm your onboarding buddy. i'll send a calendar invite for a 30m repo + runbook walkthrough. for VPC access ping eng-infra-bot and cc @it-helpdesk.

it-helpdesk: Ticket IT-5099 created for Omar Basu: Temporary dev VM provisioned (ubuntu-22.04). SSH: obasu@temp-dev-231.redwood.internal. SSH key added to 1Password -> "IT Temp Keys". Laptop tracking updated to 'shipped'.

eng-infra-bot: Added Omar Basu to org "redwood-inference" and teams: eng-infra, oncall-sre. Please accept the GitHub invite sent to your email. Request submitted for staging VPC access; approvers: infra-leads.

Omar Basu: awesome, thanks everyone. i'll try the temp VM now. also will bring a slice of sourdough to the virtual coffee tomorrow if that's allowed :grin:

Nora (People Ops): love the sourdough offer! welcome omar. FYI our welcome kit includes a small plants pack if you want one shipped. ping me with your address.

Hannah Li: see you at the team intro later today 3pm PT. bring bread pics :camera_with_flash:
